narrative_goal: Show that global income inequality has worsened over recent decades, with the top 1%'s share of global income rising from 16% in 1980 to 20.5% in 2015 while the bottom 50%'s share remained near 8–9.5%.
intent_en: Compare the share of global income held by the top percentile and the bottom half of the population from 1980 to 2015.
